Mangrove

A toy, not a model. Everything here comes from code and one seed: the muddy coast, the tide and the trees, grown by simple rules made up for play. Nothing is measured and the place is not real.

Drag to turn, pinch or scroll to zoom, two fingers or right-drag to move. Double-tap to go back. The slider sets the time of day; the look button changes how day, dusk and night are drawn. On the right: plant mangroves, build a dyke, take sand, let the years run fast, send a storm, turn the sound off or on, and make a postcard to share. Tap an animal to read its rule.

The sound is made in code too, and starts with your first touch.

This world: . The link carries this coast and what you did to it.

For a real coast, see the vanishing coast of the Mekong Delta.
